candidates.statement: A. Use Statement This guidance provides qualification recommendations for the use of plasma fibrinogen, measured at baseline, as a prognostic biomarker to select patients with COPD at high risk for exacerbations and/or all-cause mortality for inclusion in interventional clinical trials. This biomarker should be considered with other demographic and clinical characteristics, including a prior history of COPD exacerbations, as an enrichment factor in these trials.

1. Assay An analytically validated assay should be used for measurement of plasma fibrinogen. (Please see supporting documentation for details at Biomarker Qualification Program: Qualified Biomarkers and Supporting Information .)
candidates.context: B. Conditions for Qualified Use 2. Plasma Fibrinogen-Based Patient Selection in Clinical Trials a. PLASMA FIBRINOGEN LEVEL The plasma fibrinogen level of patients selected for clinical trials should be determined at baseline.

candidates.statement: consistent with an increased risk for exacerbations and/or all-cause mortality (i.e., Global Initiative for Chronic Obstructive Lung Disease (GOLD Stage II or higher). Patients enrolled in COPD exacerbation trials should also have a prior history of COPD exacerbations in the year prior to enrollment in the clinical trial.
candidates.context: 1 ATS/ERS, 2004, Standards for the Diagnosis and Management of Patients with COPD, available on the Internet at https://www.thoracic.org/copd-guidelines/resources/copddoc.pdf . c. PATIENT SELECTION Plasma fibrinogen can be used as an enrichment factor, in addition to standard inclusion/exclusion criteria, in COPD clinical trials with endpoints of COPD exacerbation and/or all-cause mortality.

candidates.statement: Because fibrinogen was qualified using multiple assays, an optimal enrichment threshold has not been determined. Therefore, a drug sponsor should propose an appropriate threshold for a baseline plasma fibrinogen level and discuss it with FDA during the protocol development phase.
candidates.context: c. PATIENT SELECTION Plasma fibrinogen can be used as an enrichment factor, in addition to standard inclusion/exclusion criteria, in COPD clinical trials with endpoints of COPD exacerbation and/or all-cause mortality. (Please see supporting information for details at Biomarker Qualification Program: Qualified Biomarkers and Supporting Information .) d. MEASUREMENT APPLICABILITY Fibrinogen was qualified primarily based on the Evaluation of COPD Longitudinally to Identify Predictive Surrogate End-points (ECLIPSE) study data that used an immunological assay that measured a range of fibrinogen concentrations between 100-900 milligrams/deciliter. Any analytically validated method can be used to measure fibrinogen.
